SALES_SOURCE copies/replica. paid/preparing/shipped/delivered AND successful non-test direct OR checkout-batch payment; copies use snapshot-computed paid. Credit-term success at checkout counts and does not prove cash received. Native declared THB incl VAT after discounts before refunds; no per-row currency field. Counts and SUM numeric::text are read directly, not rounded legacy float projections.

sourceAudit.source: Order copy amount and lifecycle contract
sourceAudit.available: Five separately recorded nullable monetary fields: total_price, subtotal_ex_vat, vat_amount, discount_inc_vat, delivery_fee. Amount rows can be missing/zero/negative. Preserve exact signed cents and count known/missing/negative rows. Never divide all totals by 1.07 or subtract discounts again. source_version=0 is legacy; copied_at means a local write, not upstream freshness. Old snapshots omitting refunds retain existing children; presence of order rows does not prove refund backfill.

sourceAudit.source: Refund record timing and copied composite identity
sourceAudit.available: Record status refunded, created_at in selected calendar month; copies FK orders_id/composite(orders_id,id), replica projection FK order_id. Amount/created_at/processed_at are source fields. Processed time shown only as evidence. Ticket-created date differs from accounting recognition and underlying order date; missing/negative amounts, unlinked order dates and order dates outside the month are visible. Never subtract refund totals from this order-created-month total. Replica columns/availability remain subject to deployment contract confirmation; query failure yields unavailable instead of zero. Migration source was read, never executed.

Existing Winback team GMV and GMV-target context uses its own configured source and full UTC month. Keep separate from financial source, net sales and actual profit. Bangkok boundary mismatch is explicit. Owner-private selected target/metric/revision shown; actual, variance and attainment remain null even for matching UTC months.

calculationContract.windows: Half-open [month start, next month start). UTC or original fixed UTC+7 Bangkok rule. Each month may have a different number of calendar days; no daily-rate normalization. Current open month flagged; no closed-month completeness claim.
calculationContract.precision: PostgreSQL numeric::text; exact BigInt signed cents; delta=current minus reference; percentage=delta/reference*100 half-up four places only for positive reference. Zero/negative reference permits signed delta with percentage null and reason.
calculationContract.eligibility: Compare only compatible source, timezone, declared currency/native currency evidence and order-header monetary basis; missing required field value blocks that field only. No combining SKU quantities or UOM, currencies or different sources.
calculationContract.partial: Known sum is explicitly partial when any field rows are missing; comparison value null. A successful empty local query can report zero eligible order sum but never complete business absence. Empty refunds have knownAmount null. Outage/malformed source yields null availability and reasons. Whole upstream coverage always partial/unavailable.
calculationContract.snapshot: Each order summary and its sample is one statement snapshot. Order/refund and two period reads are independent local statements, not a globally consistent accounting ledger or sync watermark.
calculationContract.drilldown: Only eligible source records in the selected month; max20 linked samples with actual total counts/hasMore; no inferred cause, product contribution ranking, owner assignment or outbound workflow.
